purpose: select the smallest credible ordinary public CollabUtils2 collab that proves one real lobby and multiple subordinate maps

screening.ranking: Prefer one lobby, two to five subordinate maps, small room/content scope, no prologue or gym, no Lua/native/configured IL/general DynamicData, and the least helper breadth that still proves CollabUtils2.

candidates.name: hennyburgr's Mapping Competition Entries
candidates.reason: Exact smallest useful graph: one one-room lobby, two one-room maps, no managed payload, no FMOD bank, Lua, native payload, prologue, gym, configured IL, direct hooks, or ModInterop; every required helper use admits bounded hash-locked static semantics.

candidates.name: BevWeek
candidates.reason: Small map count, but requires broader VivHelper, OutbackHelper and PandorasBox behavior than the selected graph.

candidates.name: 2025 Secret Santa Collab
candidates.reason: Small structure but requires rainbow/door/silver systems plus Strawberry Jam CommunalHelper and several broader helpers.

candidates.name: Chocolate Goop
candidates.reason: Large maps, custom audio and broad Gravity/Viv/Vortex/MaxHelpingHand behavior.

candidates.name: 1 Hour Alone Contest
candidates.reason: Broader map and helper scope with mini-heart door, rainbow, silver and golden semantics.

candidates.name: 1 Hour Alone Contest
candidates.reason: Still needs broader CollabUtils2 berry/door semantics and CrystalBombDetonator.

candidates.name: Error and Slimer Map Pack
candidates.reason: Requires broad Gravity, Fancy, Communal, Frost, Shroom and helper-specific behavior.

candidates.name: The Kayonara Collection
candidates.reason: Exercises speed/rainbow/silver/golden/door systems and a substantially broader helper closure.

candidates.name: Mt. Rainier
candidates.reason: Requires AdventureHelper, BounceHelper and additional custom behaviors unrelated to first lobby proof.

candidates.name: Nature's Gift
candidates.reason: Larger physical scope and wider mini-heart/door/rainbow/silver/helper surface.

candidates.name: Xolimono's Silly Things
candidates.reason: Requires ExtendedVariantMode, FactoryHelper and more helper behavior.

candidates.name: Technical Difficulty
candidates.reason: Large maps and broader Communal SJ, Vortex, Frost and ExtendedVariant behavior.

candidates.name: The Catacombs
candidates.reason: Requires Brokemia, Contort, ExtendedVariant and mini-heart-door completion behavior.

candidates.name: Verthday Collab
candidates.reason: Requires warp pedestal, rainbow, silver, door and numerous helper-specific mechanics.

candidates.name: Wollab 4
candidates.reason: Far outside the bounded first-collab scope: 61 maps and a very broad helper/content graph.

candidates.name: World Map Helper Test
candidates.reason: Uses WorldMapHelper world-map semantics rather than ordinary CollabUtils2 lobby semantics.

candidates.name: CollabUtils2
candidates.reason: Pinned behavior source and exact static-semantic dependency, not a playable collab candidate.

candidates.name: BevWeek
candidates.reason: Later package is larger and adds Adventure, Crystalline, Frost, MaxHelpingHand, StyleMask and Viv requirements.

selected.name: hennyburgr's Mapping Competition Entries
